reference_description: Unmodified V8 12.6 JSON.parse/stringify are correctness and exact-error oracles, not the performance comparator; original 12.6 has no parseAsync.

notes: Uninstrumented timings/RSS are the performance gate. Matched instrumented builds supply foreground p95 and max.
Ratios pool all accepted paired attempts; overlaps alone are excluded with their full records retained.
Each USGS single-job input is checked against the 10% target, stricter than using only an expanded-group average.
A four-job entry measurement is the total synchronous time to submit all four calls.

scanner-sanitizers.scope: macOS ARM64 native scalar and NEON, candidate scanner source; standalone scanner only

asan-profile-final-validation.interval_checked: Full RunInternal body including re-enqueue and scope exit; entry/native accounting separated, nested foreground phases fit whole slices.
asan-profile-final-validation.thresholds_verified: Below 4Mi no split; 4Mi through 16Mi-1 four array parts; at least 16Mi eight array parts. Logical remaining tapes also include the suffix.

limits: Test262 scripts check standard synchronous APIs; async semantics are checked by independent differential suites and new object-array cases.
ASan+DCHECK+VERIFY_HEAP executes the shared object algorithm on macOS ARM64 with an isolated platform admission change. Android release native tests and output parity cover actual ARM32/ARM64 code.
ASan+UBSan standalone tests cover the shared scalar/NEON scanner; no claim of whole-engine UBSan coverage.
28 invalid UTF-8 byte fixtures are out of scope for a UTF-16 string API, as recorded by the pinned upstream corpus manifest. Escaped and raw UTF-16 edge cases remain covered.

notes: All _us timers are wall-clock intervals, not summed worker CPU time.
entry/build/foreground/total are inclusive intervals; subphases and GC counters overlap. Do not add them all together.
Memory accounting at API entry and inside foreground tasks are separate.
Four-job GC is max(gc_end)-min(gc_start) for each complete batch; overlapping document windows are never summed.
parts counts remaining logical tapes, including outer-object prefix/suffix segmentation; it is not worker count. Worker array partitions remain capped at eight.
Formal completion/entry/RSS conclusions use uninstrumented builds; foreground p95/max uses matched final diagnostic builds.

notes: All initial and follow-up samples are retained; no RSS outlier removal or heap-limit changes.
